words.name: Warm
words.line: Friendlier, a little longer; names Hindi and Urdu.

ask.b: Nth can turn your voice into text, right here on your PC. It needs a one-time {mb} download.

yes.b: It will be ready as soon as the download finishes. Click the voice orb in the composer any time to see how it’s going. Want a different model? It’s in {path}.

ready.b: Click the voice orb in the composer and start talking. Want a different model? It’s in {path}.

no.b: Nothing was downloaded. Whenever you’d like voice typing, click the voice orb in the composer and the download starts. You can pick the model in {path}.

slow.t: How should voice typing work here?
slow.b: Your PC can’t write your words live with the accurate model. Which matters more to you?
slow.live_t: See my words as I speak
slow.live_d: Uses a smaller model ({small} more). It hears languages other than English less well, Hindi and Urdu most.
slow.acc_d: Keeps the accurate model; your text appears when you stop speaking.
slow.foot: You can switch any time in {path}.

slowlive.b: The smaller model is on its way. You can switch any time in {path}.

slowacc.b: Your text appears when you stop speaking. You can switch any time in {path}.
